cases.name: Role matrix: admin uploads/manages; only accountants and all warehouse roles read file bytes
Retries and concurrent double submits create exactly one document
PDF, images and Office containers preserve the original bytes
Executable, HTML/SVG, spoofed MIME/signatures, broken Office archives and traversal filenames are rejected
Empty and oversized files are rejected before persistence
Account revocation and stale membership versions deny access immediately
Portal/forged identities cannot use CRM document privileges
Search returns metadata only and upload actions are audited
Stored file checksums are validated on reads and included in database backup checks
Upload rate limit allows thirty files per admin per hour and rejects the next

officeScope: Container validation and byte preservation; no Office application rendering claim
